control.first_sample_family_gate: For each Q cluster, inspect its first M0 sample before dispatching the remaining four M0 samples. If the first sample reveals a fixture ambiguity, stop that cluster and repair the protocol before any additional sample.
control.control_rule: Run and judge all M0 viability cases before any comparison. For each Q cluster run five independent M0 controls. Run H1 only if the registered defect or meaningful quality deficit appears while M0 remains viable.

scored.trace: Each case's facts with the Vxx-F prefix uniquely establish one eligible route, failure branch, capacity row, ledger state, or terminal decision.

Every case sets mutation_boundary to none.
Each requested_output fixes the evidence and fields that must be returned.
